name: Blog index header, featured post and subscribe callout
purpose: Open the blog index with its H1, spotlight the latest post and capture newsletter interest (static form) above the filterable list.
description: Legacy 'green' styling inside side hairlines (/resources/blog-and-news): (1) page header row with eyebrow tag, serif 3.8rem H1 and 20px lead; (2) a featured-post link card, 0.8fr image | 1fr content (H2-sized title, grey excerpt, 'Written by' avatar + author, date and read-time tags), one column <=767 and meta row reversed <=479; (3) a #001811 subscribe callout with a heading, sub line and a static email field + button (no submission). The SubscribeCallout part is also exported and reused by EventsUpcoming.
